stories.title: Kraken adds DeFi yield to tokenized stocks and ETFs
stories.summary: Kraken said it will let users earn DeFi-based yield on tokenized stocks and ETFs on its platform. The move links traditional equity products with crypto-native yield mechanisms. The announcement gives few details on which assets qualify or how yield is generated.
stories.whyItMatters: It shows exchanges pushing further into merging traditional securities with on-chain yield, a trend regulators watch closely.
whatToWatch: Which tokenized stocks and ETFs get yield first
Regulatory reaction to yield-bearing tokenized equities
User uptake of the new feature
questions: How is the yield generated and funded?
Does this draw securities-law scrutiny?

stories.title: Bitmine adds $68M in Ethereum, holdings near 6 million ETH
stories.summary: Bitmine Immersion Technologies bought another $68 million of Ethereum, pushing its treasury holdings close to 6 million ETH. The purchase continues the company's aggressive ETH accumulation strategy.
stories.whyItMatters: Bitmine's buying is now large enough to influence ETH supply dynamics and signals strong institutional conviction in Ethereum as a treasury asset.
whatToWatch: Whether Bitmine's holdings cross 6 million ETH
Further disclosed purchases
Bitmine's staking plans for the stack
questions: How is Bitmine funding these purchases?
What is the end goal for such a large single-entity ETH position?

stories.title: S&P Global backs Kaiko as crypto data firm's Series B hits $110M
stories.summary: Crypto market-data provider Kaiko raised its Series B round to $110 million, with S&P Global among the backers. The investment shows a traditional financial-data incumbent buying into crypto market infrastructure.
stories.whyItMatters: S&P Global's participation suggests mainstream finance sees lasting demand for institutional-grade crypto price and reference data.
whatToWatch: How Kaiko deploys the new funding
Any product integration between Kaiko and S&P Global
Responses from competing data providers
questions: What stake did S&P Global take?
Could this lead to a deeper partnership or acquisition later?

stories.title: BlackRock's staking Ethereum ETF pays yield, but investors still favor its $9B ETHA fund
stories.summary: BlackRock's newer Ethereum ETF that pays staking yield has not pulled flows away from its existing $9 billion ETHA fund. Investors appear to prefer the established, non-staking product despite the added yield feature.
stories.whyItMatters: The gap shows yield alone may not shift institutional flows, a signal for how issuers structure future crypto ETF products.
whatToWatch: Flow data for both funds in coming weeks
Whether BlackRock changes fees or marketing
Staking ETF launches from other issuers
questions: Why aren't investors moving to the yield-bearing fund?
Are there tax or structural drawbacks to the staking version?

stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs lose $463M as Ether ETFs gain $197M in weekly reversal
stories.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $463 million in net outflows over the week, while Ether ETFs took in $197 million. The divergence marks a reversal from prior flow trends that had favored Bitcoin.
stories.whyItMatters: ETF flows are a real-time gauge of institutional sentiment, and a rotation from Bitcoin into Ether funds could signal a shift in allocation preferences.
whatToWatch: Whether the rotation continues next week
Bitcoin price action relative to the outflows
Ether ETF flow trend versus BlackRock's ETHA dynamics
questions: What is driving the rotation—macro conditions or a specific large holder?

stories.title: Strive adds 469 Bitcoin, brings treasury to 25,000 BTC
stories.summary: Strive purchased 469 more Bitcoin, growing its total holdings to 25,000 BTC. The purchase continues the firm's pattern of steady, incremental accumulation.
stories.whyItMatters: It adds to the growing list of corporate Bitcoin treasuries, a trend that concentrates supply and ties corporate balance sheets to BTC price swings.
whatToWatch: Future purchase disclosures from Strive
How the treasury size compares with peers like Strategy
Market reaction to continued corporate BTC buying
questions: How is Strive financing these purchases?

stories.title: Bitcoin exchanges could cut quantum-computing exposure ahead of network upgrade
stories.summary: CryptoSlate reports that Bitcoin exchanges have options to reduce their exposure to quantum-computing risk before an anticipated network upgrade meant to address the threat. The report frames quantum resistance as a growing technical priority for the network.
stories.whyItMatters: Quantum computing is a long-horizon but serious risk to Bitcoin's cryptography, and how exchanges and the protocol prepare affects long-term confidence in the network's security.
whatToWatch: Timeline for the referenced network upgrade
Which exchanges act first on quantum exposure
Community consensus on a quantum-resistance roadmap
questions: How soon could quantum computing pose a real threat?
What specific upgrade is being proposed?

stories.title: Strategy buys back $139M of STRC as Bitcoin stack stays frozen a second week
stories.summary: Strategy repurchased $139 million of its STRC shares while leaving its Bitcoin holdings unchanged for a second consecutive week. The pause in BTC buying contrasts with the company's usual accumulation cadence.
stories.whyItMatters: Strategy's Bitcoin purchases are closely watched as a bellwether of corporate demand, so a pause alongside a share buyback signals a shift in capital priorities.
whatToWatch: Whether Strategy resumes Bitcoin purchases next week
Further STRC buyback activity
Company commentary on the reason for the pause
questions: Why has Strategy paused Bitcoin buying?
Is the STRC buyback tied to funding constraints or a strategic shift?

stories.title: Trump backed tougher ethics rules in the Clarity Act, boosting industry hopes for passage
stories.summary: Trump supported stricter ethics provisions in the crypto market-structure Clarity Act, a move the crypto industry believes improves the bill's chances of passing. The ethics rules address conflict-of-interest concerns tied to political figures' crypto holdings.
stories.whyItMatters: The Clarity Act is the leading US effort to set clear market-structure rules for crypto, so its ethics provisions and passage odds directly affect regulatory certainty for the industry.
whatToWatch: Next legislative steps and votes on the Clarity Act
Details of the specific ethics provisions added
Industry lobbying response
questions: What specific ethics rules were added?
Does support extend beyond this one provision?

stories.title: Aave V4 proposal would put DAO treasury first in line for lending losses
stories.summary: A new Aave V4 proposal would have the protocol's DAO-controlled funds absorb lending losses before other stakeholders. The change aims to restructure how bad debt is backstopped within the protocol.
stories.whyItMatters: How DeFi protocols allocate loss risk affects depositor safety and confidence, making Aave's structural choices a bellwether for lending-protocol design.
whatToWatch: Outcome of the Aave governance vote
Reaction from large depositors and stakers
Whether other lending protocols adopt a similar model
questions: How large is the DAO fund relative to potential losses?
What happens if DAO funds are depleted?

stories.whyItMatters: A major economy testing tokenized bonds signals growing government interest in blockchain market infrastructure, which could shape regulatory templates elsewhere.

questions: Which regulator or agency runs the pilot?
